title: fix(ui): use bordered Pollinations Connect button
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reuses the shared bordered brand button with an inline Pollinations icon.
- Removes the separate amber icon cell in both Connect sizes.
- Bumps @pollinations/ui to 0.1.0-alpha.8.

Validation: 111 UI tests, typecheck, package build, and light/dark browser preview passed.

gist.headline: One button, fewer boxes
gist.blurb: The Connect button gets a tidier outline. Its Pollinations icon sits inside the button instead of occupying a little amber room of its own.
gist.summary: The app user menu reuses the shared bordered Pollinations Connect button with an inline icon in both sizes, and bumps @pollinations/ui to 0.1.0-alpha.8.
gist.impact: People using the app user menu get a consistent bordered Connect button in both sizes, without the separate amber icon cell.
gist.visual_concept: Show a cozy interface workshop where Polli helps fit a small Pollinations icon neatly inside a bordered Connect button. Two button sizes sit side by side; the shared border and inline placement are the point, with a code-plant and warm lime glow tying the scene together.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art interface workshop, Polli gently adjusts a tiny Pollinations icon inside two bordered buttons labeled 'CONNECT', one small and one large, beside a glowing code-plant and a prominent lime green (#ecf874) workbench. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt, stays small-to-medium in the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, and a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background.
